subject: Collecting brief ROI & publishing consent for renewal materials - Uptick Health
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda@uptickhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Short ROI quote for renewal packet (3 sentences)

Hi Amanda,

Hope you had a good week — quick ask as we pull together the renewal/expansion packet for Uptick. Could you and/or Kevin share a 2–3 sentence quote on the top-line business impact you’ve seen from Redwood (e.g., % reduction in processing cost, latency improvements, or engagement lift)? We’re building a short "customer outcomes" sidebar for the renewal deck and would like a concise customer-facing line we can use in collateral and the renewal email to your execs.

I attached a one-page template to make it as quick as possible (Uptick_ROI_Template.docx). If you prefer, you can reply inline with a sentence or two. Also let me know if you need approvals from your legal/comms team before we publish.

Thanks — really appreciate it. Our renewal team (cc’d Monica) will incorporate this into the one-pager.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: Uptick_ROI_Template.docx (docx)

From: Amanda Chen <amanda@uptickhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Lo <klo@uptickhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short ROI quote for renewal packet (3 sentences)

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the template, this is helpful.

Draft quote here that I can sign off on internally: "Since moving inference to Redwood, our per-transaction inference cost dropped ~22% and median latency improved from 340ms to ~120ms, which materially accelerated clinical workflow throughput. Redwood’s predictable serving helped us scale without additional engineering effort."

We’re happy to give permission to use that on the renewal materials and on a short customer story, pending a quick legal review. I’ve forwarded to our legal alias and copied Kevin for ops confirmation.

I attached a signed approval snapshot once legal confirms (I will follow up) — if you need it as a scanned PDF I can send that.

Best,
Amanda Chen
Head of Product Operations, Uptick Health
amanda@uptickhealth.com

Attachment: Uptick_Approval_Scan.pdf (pdf)
